request: Analyze GSE142678 for PMID 32755589 (RGS6 Mediates Effects of Voluntary Running on Adult Hippocampal Neurogenesis.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: RiboTag-seq (bulk RNA-seq, SMARTer Stranded Total RNA-Seq v2, HiSeq 2500 SE100) of HA-tagged ribosome IP (Nestin-CreERT2 lineage: adult-born DG neurons) and matched input (IN, whole dentate gyrus) RNA
final.primary_estimand: Effect of voluntary wheel running vs sedentary on translating-mRNA expression in adult-born DG neurons (IP) and in DG tissue (IN), separately at 11, 18 and 27 days of running
final.sample_inclusion: 24 libraries = 2 fractions x 3 durations x 2 conditions x 2 replicates; each replicate is a pool of dentate gyri from 2-4 mice (S4.3.7.p1); 12 IP samples (S2.1.p2)
planned_contrasts: Running vs Sedentary, IP, 11 days (S2.1.p3, Fig 1E; count only in figure)
Running vs Sedentary, IP, 18 days (S4.3.8.p1: N=460 DEGs at Day-18, used for the IP trajectory)
Running vs Sedentary, IP, 27 days (S2.1.p3 / Fig 1F: 508 unique + 36 shared = 544 DEGs)
Running vs Sedentary, IN, 11 days (Fig 1E; count only in figure)
Running vs Sedentary, IN, 18 days (Fig 1E; count only in figure)
Running vs Sedentary, IN, 27 days (S2.1.p3: 88 unique + 36 shared = 124; S3.p5: 124 DEGs)
final.repeated_measure_unit: not_reported (IP and IN of one replicate come from the same lysate, but the fractions are analyzed separately; no within-fraction pairing stated)
final.paper_method: EBSeq embedded in RSEM, separately per fraction and time point (S2.1.p2, S4.3.7.p1)

paper_threshold.adjustment: EBSeq PPEE (posterior probability of equal expression)

final.display_rule: Fig 3A volcano colors genes with |FC| > 1.5 and p < 0.05 (display only)
final.paper_results: Rgs6 top up in IP (all three times), not in IN; Abca8a top down in IP and IN; Bdnf up in IP and IN; Calb2 up in IP only; shared IP/IN DEGs: 11d Mylk3 up, 18d Ttr up and Csmd3 down, 27d 36 shared (29 opposite direction)

final.formula: ~ 0 + cell (cell = group x time), fitted separately per fraction

design.reasoning: Paper compares running vs sedentary within each duration, separately for IP (adult-born neurons, the paper's focus) and IN (DG tissue) (S2.1.p2-p3, Fig 1E-F). Fraction is a stratum (different RNA populations); within a fraction one cell-means model over the six group x time cells pools the residual variance (12 samples, 6 df) while each contrast stays within one duration. Every arm has n = 2 pooled replicates, so all six contrasts are exploratory by the n < 3 rule; small n is not a stop. Time-course and interaction comparisons are not the paper's estimand and are not run.
